Regra no lugar da foto: A rule where the photo was
branco na mesa do posto: blank paper on the post table
com cheiro de café passado na hora: with the smell of fresh brewed coffee
e a gráfica que imprima: and let the printer print it
E se eu botar cachoeira: And if I put waterfall on it
olha a palavra aventura no folheto velho: looks at the word adventure on the old leaflet
lê a lista baixinho: reads the list under her breath
ri sozinha do risco duplo: she laughs at the double line
Em junho o folheto novo sai com: In June the new leaflet comes out with
as regras impressas antes da foto: the rules printed before the photo
ela esperava não chega nunca: she was waiting for never comes
